definitions: Alternative letter-case form of Baltic (“very cold”).
A European fresh-water cyprinoid fish of the genus Abramis, little valued as food. Several species are known.
A species in that genus, Abramis brama.
To clean (e.g. a ship's bottom of clinging shells, seaweed, etc.) by the application of fire and scraping.

blocks.text: Bream are species of freshwater fish belonging to a variety of genera including Abramis, Ballerus, Blicca, Chilotilapia, Etelis, Lepomis, Gymnocranius, Lethrinus, Nemipterus, Pharyngochromis, Rhabdosargus, Scolopsis, or Serranochromis.
